items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: Sidney, we used to take lessons from Piku, same time.

ctx.x: I didn't just went over there, nothing else felt like. Took a little lesson, me and Piku. Another boy that died, uh, Hanukkah, Armageddon, uh, Sidney Veen. That's a classic where he died, too. I mean, Sidney, we used to take lessons from Piku, same time.
What kind of a clarinet player was Piku in those days? Piku was a good clarinet player.
